titled State Vs. Surendra Kumar and others, under Sections 7 and 16 Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 as well as the summoning order dated 2.12.2002 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II, Rae Bareli.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicant has stated that the proceedings before the trial court have been stayed by the Hon'ble Apex Court, as there was no interim stay order by this Court.
On the last date of hearing i.e. on 2.12.2024, time was granted to the learned counsel for applicant to produce the copy of interim stay order passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court.
Needful has not been done, and again a request for adjournment has been made, but this Court is M/S.Britannia Industries Ltd. vs State Of U.P.Through Food Inspector ...
